title: Offline password manager for Windows
lead: Encrypted vault for passwords, keys and notes. No cloud, no account, no network access at all.

hero.caption: Main screen: entry cards with login, hidden password and website, plus type filters.
hero.alt: Main screen: entry cards with login, hidden password and website, plus type filters.

problem: Passwords scattered in a browser, notes or on paper are unsafe. Cloud password managers keep them on someone else's server and need an account. People want a tool where everything is encrypted and stays with them.
built: Encryption: AES-256-GCM (a modified file simply will not open), with the key derived from the master password by Argon2id (64 MiB memory, 3 passes).
No network at all: no sync, no telemetry, no update checks.
Entries: passwords, protected notes, custom fields.
Auto-lock after inactivity (5 minutes by default); Ctrl+L locks at once.
Careful saving through a temporary file, with the previous version kept as a backup.

shots.caption: New entry: a password generator with length and character-set options.
shots.alt: New entry: a password generator with length and character-set options.

shots.caption: Settings: master password change, auto-lock after 15 minutes, theme and accent.
shots.alt: Settings: master password change, auto-lock after 15 minutes, theme and accent.

shots.caption: Unlock with the master password: the file is encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and cannot be opened without it; no network.
shots.alt: Unlock with the master password: the file is encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and cannot be opened without it; no network.

shots.caption: Narrow window: the cards reflow into two columns.
shots.alt: Narrow window: the cards reflow into two columns.

steps: Create a vault with a master password.
Add entries; search with Ctrl+K and copy with one click.
The vault locks itself after inactivity.
Export an encrypted backup whenever you like.
offer: Installing Vault for you or adapting it: your own entry types, name and look, language.
Or a similar vault for your task (team secrets, keys, licences).
An installer and a portable version.
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
